g.text: Smooth pinch-to-zoom, pan inertia, and double-tap zoom for any view.
Built on react-native-gesture-handler & Animated — zero Reanimated required.

text.tspan: Pinch, pan, and double-tap recognizers run simultaneously.
Double-tap smoothly cycles minZoom → midpoint → maxZoom.
Strict boundary calculation keeps scaled content within viewport.
Cubic inertia projection decays smoothly on gesture release.
Pure Animated.timing transitions running on the native UI thread.
Defaults to JS thread for zero setup, with optional UI thread execution.
